name: SBI EfficientNet-B0 on per-frame face crops (video-frames runtime)
source_url: local training: experiments/train_detector.py on self-blend corpus (see experiments/FACESWAP_EVALUATION.md); frame wrapper uses the committed sbi-effnet-runtime.json inner config
limitations: This is the measured faceswap path for video: faces are detected per sampled frame (MediaPipe + Haar fallback) and scored by the SBI member — the member with AUROC ~0.87 on held-out face manipulation.
Frames without detectable faces are skipped, not scored as authentic.
Not a temporal model — per-frame face scores are averaged; lip-sync/inter-frame drift is not modeled.
Heavy compression/low-resolution faces degrade detection (documented in experiments/FACESWAP_EVALUATION.md).
Checkpoint is not committed; reproduce via scripts + experiments/train_detector.py.
Scores are a prioritization signal, not a truth label.
